title: X6857-16.2.0.140SP10-OP010PF001AZ-16.2.0.150SP09-OP004PF001AZ_20260709203559
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6857-16.2.0.150SP09(OP004PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
1. Updated Google Security Patch to July 1, 2026.
2. Optimized TikTok launch performance to reduce cold and hot start times.
3. Optimized memory usage of the persistent charging service process.
4. Optimized for stuttering in scenarios such as swiping up in Facebook, Wi-Fi pop-ups, and excessive connectivity notifications after reconnecting following a long network outage.

Fixed Issues:
1. Fixed the video playback stuttering issue when a headset was connected to the phone.
2. Fixed the issue where playback videos had no sound after recording the screen in TikTok.
3. Optimized device temperature during multi-app switching and video recording.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
